query:
UPDATE agent_runs
                SET epoch = epoch + 1,
                    committed_seq = $2,
                    state = CASE WHEN state = 'ended' THEN state
                                 WHEN state = 'finalizing' THEN state
                                 ELSE 'active' END,
                    late_resume = late_resume OR state = 'abandoned',
                    detached_at = NULL,
                    last_frame_at = now(),
                    rev = rev + 1
              WHERE id = $1
              RETURNING epoch
